transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I just feel... worn down almost all the time. It doesn't really seem to matter if I get a full night's sleep, I still wake up feeling tired. By the time I get through my work day at the lab and try to deal with the clutter around the house, I just... I have very little energy left for anything else. It's just been a constant struggle lately.
How long have you been feeling this constant tiredness and low energy—days, weeks, or months?

Honestly, it's been longer than months. It's been... well, this kind of low baseline has been going on since shortly after we moved into our older house. So, that would be a little over two years ago.
Over these past two years, have you also noticed a persistent low or sad mood, or a loss of interest in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Most days there's just this... low, gray mood running in the background. I mean, I can still go to the lab and talk to people and get my work done, but I don't really feel light or excited about things anymore. Even stuff I used to really enjoy, like baking or taking out the telescope... I just don't have that same interest in them the way I used to.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly or that you seem to stop breathing or gasp for air while you're asleep?
No, not that I know of. My husband hasn't ever mentioned anything like that to me, and I don't think I wake myself up gasping or anything. I just... I just don't feel rested when I wake up.
Have you noticed any unexplained weight gain, feeling unusually cold, or constipation over the past couple of years?
No, I haven't noticed any of that. My weight has stayed pretty much the same, and I don't feel colder than usual or have any stomach issues like that. It's really just the tiredness and the mood.
Have you noticed any dizziness, lightheadedness, unusual paleness, or shortness of breath when you exert yourself?
No, I haven't noticed any of that. I don't get dizzy or short of breath, and I don't think I'm unusually pale. Like I said, it's really just the fatigue and feeling down.

Over these past two years, has there ever been a period of a few weeks or more where your mood and energy became noticeably worse than your usual baseline, to the point where it was hard to function normally?

No, not really. It's just been a steady... kind of a low point the whole time. I haven't had any sudden drops where things got way worse or anything like that. It's just a constant feeling of being tired and down.
Do you have trouble actually falling asleep or staying asleep at night, or is it more that you sleep through the night but still wake up feeling unrefreshed?

I don't really have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, no. I usually sleep through the night just fine. It's more the second thing you said—I sleep, but when I wake up, I just don't feel rested. I'm still tired.
